Level 3 requires an assessment where coordination between people AND tools/AI systems is itself assessed; no core assessment does this in the extract.

C3.rationale: Level 1: digital tools appear only as tool operation/training — ABPL90074 'introduces CAD as the graphic medium for documentation' and grades CAD-skill development; ABPL90170 uses 'advanced digital tools for spatial analysis, modelling, and visual representation'. No AI-specific content (capabilities, limitations, ethics, governance) appears anywhere, so Levels 2 and 3 are unreachable.

evidenceLines: Students will apply their chosen focus to real-world projects, developing their ability to analyse, structure, and implement effective design solutions.
